title_cyr: Има една земја сонце што ја грее
title_latin: Ima edna zemja sonce što ja gree
title_en: There is a land that the sun warms
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Modern patriotic song; I cannot name an author, so origin unclear. The three rivers/mountains/sea (Vardar, Pirin, Aegean) stand for the three parts of geographic Macedonia; the 'Нека живеј' in the first refrain is a spelling variant of 'Нека живее'. Lines 3-6 of the third stanza are my reading.
